notes.title: QOL Update - Patch Notes v1.3.4!
notes.content:
Hello, Rainbow Baes!

[h3]Patch v.1.3.4[/h3]

We've been working on some Quality of Life changes that we're starting to roll out beginning with this patch, thanks to community feedback. Since patch v1.3.2, the following changes have been deployed:

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Gravy (Maribel's dog) now has a torso again in her intro - congratulations!
[*] edits to the Act 1 & 2 fixed scenes to add content & VFX
[*] UI noise now sounds on Dogagotchi event
[*] UI indicator on how to access gameplay menu added
[*] Dog Quality Time no longer says a bonus is given due to high energy when there is none energy
[*] More activities in Dog Quality Time now restore energy
[*] Paws Academy is no longer the Harvard of dog schools [strike](rebalanced to make getting golds/Valedictorian achievement easier)[/strike]
[*] some minor UI fixes to 'makey look nicey'
[*] some minor dialogue fixes
[/list]

If you'd like to send us a bug report or some feedback, please jump on our [b]Discord[/b] https://discord.gg/starcolt and let us know! Alternatively, you can let us know by reporting it on this form: https://forms.gle/N9svcDEf631LXTwJ7

We'll continue to work on QOL in the meantime!

Thanks,
 
Team Starcolt

notes.title: Steam Community Items Released + Patch Notes v1.1.5!
notes.content:
Hello, Rainbow Baes!

[h3]Steam Community Items[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35663798/d0fd8790e10f30838b8c5aeff7c90cad51e4bdba.png[/img]

Some news from our side - you asked, and we listened! Steam Community Items are now available for Best Friend Forever, and if you've played BFF before this point, you're likely to have some sparkling brand new trading cards in your inventory. Enjoy the emotes, backgrounds, trading cards and badges!

[h3]Patch v.1.1.5[/h3]

Since patch v1.1.1, the following changes have been deployed for Steam:

[b]Features/Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] added various SFX to DCT, Woofr, Adoption & Map.
[*] music tracks now fade out during dialogue scenes instead of stopping instantly.
[*] adjust default volumes for music & voice (only applies for new installs).
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed cursor size not applying correctly when the game starts.
[*] fixed cursor size when petting the dog.
[*] fixed misc SFX issues.
[*] fixed issue where Maribel & Robin's 2nd dates weren't accessible in a new game.
[*] fixed date pins being hidden by encounter pins.
[*] fixed misc issues in Robin's 2nd date.
[/list]

If you'd like to send us a bug report or some feedback, please jump on our [b]Discord[/b] https://discord.gg/bff and let us know! Alternatively, you can let us know by reporting it on this form: https://forms.gle/N9svcDEf631LXTwJ7

Thanks,
 
Team Starcolt

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.1 + BFF's Future Features Survey
notes.content:
Hello, Rainbow Baes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35663798/5542457aebb8a4770b735a2b4ebca60dd0aee2f9.png[/img]

[h3]Since patch v1.0.5, the following issues have been fixed and deployed for Steam:
[/h3]

[list]
[*] You now get more email spam than you know what to do with! Enjoy!
[*] The game now autosaves.
[*] <REDACTED> secret achievement now unlocks - if you've achieved it, game will check for it on load and award you the achievement.
[*] Cursor size is now adjustable in settings. Lorge and in chorge.
[*] Minor fix for Sacha's second date if you PRY too much in one scene. A time and a place.
[*] Dates no longer cost all your motivation for living (8MP), ending the week immediately.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35663798/88ad8538e5fca1a2f4cb22005f73396a355f4e14.png[/img]

[h3]Best Friend Forever's Future - what would you like to see?[/h3]

Since we've ticked past launch, team Starcolt is now looking at the future of Best Friend Forever, and we'd like to consult you, the community, on where they'd like us to go most. Your feedback is super valuable to us, and will help us decide where we guide Best Friend Forever going forward - thank you for taking the time to share your answers in this survey and for all your support.

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeQ64ZPqRftdOe5wbCx9QBFdBn1PL9t8S2t-psZs45jKNq_JQ/viewform][h3][b]Fill out our survey here![/b][/h3][/url]

If you'd like to send us a bug report or some feedback, please jump on our [b]Discord[/b] https://discord.gg/bff and let us know! Alternatively, you can let us know by reporting it on this form: https://forms.gle/N9svcDEf631LXTwJ7

Thanks,
 
Team Starcolt

[/list]
If you'd like to send us a bug report or some feedback, please jump on our [b]Discord[/b] https://discord.gg/bff and let us know! Alternatively, you can let us know by reporting it on this form: https://forms.gle/N9svcDEf631LXTwJ7

Thanks,
 
Team Starcolt

notes.title: Ruff Royale, Updated Dog Care and Stat Management, and MORE DOGS. ❤
notes.content:
Hey, Best Friends!

It’s been a wee while since we announced BFF and had our debut showing at PAX West. Between all the great feedback you gave us then, to our recent playtesting sessions, we’ve collated all your comments and been hard at work. We can’t wait to show the new, sparkly, and well groomed BFF off to you all!

[h2]NEW DOGS[/h2]
Firstly though, we have some New Challengers! Here’s the newly announced pups that will join our Shiba Inu in Rainbow Bay's adoption clinic:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35663798/7f18c39da44682a433996b434ff0b1b3bc366505.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35663798/97d11e7c57d0a6fbd777dfad9644593e8fbffca8.png[/img]

There's one more pup to be announced soon, so keep your eyes peeled on our our Instagram and Twitter pages to catch the reveal,

[h2]IN-GAME UPDATES[/h2]
You gave us feedback; we listened. Here are some of the updates:

[list][*] Your dogs can develop friendships (or '[i]puplinks[/i]') with the love interest's dogs!
[*] An overhaul of the stat management system for you to MIN-MAX THAT DOG!
[*] Changes and updates to our dialogue and character interaction interfaces!
[*] And a bunch of stuff we can't share with you yet because, well, secrets.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35663798/b0483dbd2d5f9f65f14c47e7f0953fbeee95f506.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35663798/1532a83d567dd2e24ec8e935f3f0d5ebdb0e1227.png[/img]

[h2]RUFF ROYALE KICKS OFF[/h2]
[i]Ruff Royale[/i], the competition to get our community’s pups into BFF, has kicked off! We can’t thank you enough for the wonderful entries of good boys and girls that we’ve received through Twitter and Discord. With our initial winners selected, the voting for the last dog standing is now in YOUR HANDS. 

[url=https://twitter.com/bffgame][b]Vote on our Twitter for your favourite dog [/b][/url]— who will show up in Paws Academy?? I’ll leave you with a taste of what we received as entries:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35663798/9994fffa1fc4f3b3773df444b23f5c45ac3ae3b5.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/DYChnas][b]A reminder that our Discord is poppin'[/b][/url] - come for the good dogs, stay for the good memes. Updates are posted frequently, and the developer team is also in there so feel free to drop by and chat. 

- Calliope x
[i](Gamerunner)[/i]
